attractions.name: Ateshgah (Fire Temple)
attractions.description: Former pilgrimage and philosophical centre of Zoroastrians from northwestern India who traded with the Caspian area; the four holy elements were Fire, Air, Water and Earth. Turned into a museum in 1975, with about 15,000 visitors per year
attractions._source_file: Azerbaijan and Georgia/Azerbaijan- All Inclusive Guide(1).docx

attractions.name: Yanardag (Fire Mountain)
attractions.description: Natural gas fire blazing continuously on a hillside on the Absheron Peninsula, with flames jetting about 3 m from a porous sandstone layer
